title: helianthus × ambiguus
intro: Helianthus × ambiguus, commonly known as the ambiguous sunflower, is a plant species within the sunflower family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high content of antioxidants and essential fatty acids. The plant has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions, such as anti-cancer properties and wound healing abilities, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and flavonoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Helianthus × ambiguus on human health, particularly regarding its bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions.
